_help: Instruments simulated in test mode ('Start test mode' on the start screen, or run.bat --sim). No real gas flows. Set address, gas, capacity and unit to match the lab; add channels to try other mixtures. 'serial' is optional: a real serial number makes test mode use that instrument's saved name, colour and max flow. tau_s = response time of the simulated flow, noise = fraction of full scale. Matches the lab MFCs (instrument report 2026-10-28: M24207457D/B/A, 1 sccm each, ~0.03 % FS noise, settles in < 1 s).
